title: Grateful Dead Live at Lille Fairgrounds on 1972-05-13
source: sbd > mr > cass > dat > cda > eac > shn v3

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with mild hiss captures a high‑energy 1972 European show highlighted by a monster The Other One > He's Gone sequence, stellar Truckin', and a flawless China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The Ladner SBD of this free Lille concert delivers solid, listenable sound despite a persistent hiss in the quiet sections. Musically the band is on fire – the first set rolls along tightly while the second set erupts into an epic The Other One → He's Gone stretch, with Truckin' and China Cat > Rider standing out as highlights. Overall the performance feels vibrant and memorable, even if a few moments sound slightly out‑of‑tune.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (13/15) rate the show 4–5 stars, praising energy and standout jams while noting only minor hiss and occasional tuning issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical SBD with noticeable hiss during quiet passages; no major drop‑outs but some reviewers mention a false start on Bertha and slight pitch irregularities in the transfer.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
The Other One (especially The Other One → He's Gone stretch)
Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard early‑1972 first set that stays tight, followed by a second set dominated by extended improvisations – The Other One → He's Gone provides the emotional peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers crisp leads on Truckin' and drives the soaring jams of The Other One with his signature tone.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir contributes slashing lead lines during Truckin' and adds energetic rhythm throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ fills add eerie texture to The Other One; keyboard work is generally solid despite occasional tuning quirks.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming underpins the long jams, with a notable driving beat during the Truckin' → The Other One transition.
